threads.body: Streaming compaction is detected only from a terminal response here. `_ResponseStreamMixin.process_event()` ignores `response.output_item.added/done`, so closing the stream or encountering a network or caller error after consuming a compaction item but before the terminal response leaves `gen_ai.conversation.compacted` unset. Set `conversation_compacted = True` when a compaction output-item event is observed, independently of content capture, and add sync/async early-close and error regression tests.

threads.body: This misses compaction items supplied through an iterator, such as `input=iter(COMPACTED_INPUT)`. `extract_params()` normalizes non-Sequence input to `None`, and the sync/async wrappers apply this check before SDK consumption without inspecting the input afterward. If the response contains no new compaction item, the span incorrectly leaves `gen_ai.conversation.compacted` unset. Observe consumed input through the shared iterator-capture path and detect compaction after SDK serialization, including lazy stream entry, without draining or replaying the iterator. Keep detection independent of content capture and add sync/async iterator-input regression tests.

replies.body: OpenAI types input as List and can't send iterators as both 2.x and 3.x raise TypeError during JSON serialization, so this path can't happen.

nit: `FetchResponseStreamWrapper` inherits `process_event`, so a streamed `responses.retrieve` replay sets `conversation_compacted` on a `FetchResponseInvocation`. It has no such field. 

Consider adding attribute to fetch span or separating inference from fetching response here.
